## About
Travis Mechanical is an HVAC and refrigeration company on Tarpley Road in Carrollton, working on homes and businesses around Dallas/Fort Worth.
At home, we take care of air conditioning and heating, from maintenance to repair to new system installation. We also clean ducts, add attic insulation, and look after the temperature control in wine rooms and wine cellars.
For businesses, we work on HVAC, refrigeration and control systems, with installation, repair, replacement and custom maintenance agreements. Our customers have given us a 4.8 rating from 208 Google reviews.

## Services
- Residential HVAC: Maintenance, repair and new system installation for your home.
- Complete AC checkup: A full checkup of your AC system. ($59)
- Duct cleaning: Helps with indoor air quality, dust, odors and allergens, and can help your system run more efficiently.
- Attic insulation: Proper insulation can help with energy savings, comfort, noise and the lifespan of your HVAC system.
- Wine room and wine cellar temperature control: Diagnosis and care for the precise temperature control that wine rooms and wine cellars need.
- Premier Maintenance Agreement: Priority scheduling, two annual visits and a 10% discount on repairs.
- HVAC and refrigeration for retailers and property managers: Keeping HVAC and refrigeration equipment running for retailers, property managers and real estate owners.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get help outside regular hours?
A: Yes. Our technicians are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Q: Will you work on a system another company installed?
A: Yes. One reviewer said we are doing a nice job maintaining a system that a different company installed.

Q: Where are you located?
A: Our shop is at 2400 Tarpley Road in Carrollton.
